name: DWTNeRF
aliases: Discrete Wavelet Transform Neural Radiance Fields
definition: A unified framework for few-shot Neural Radiance Fields based on Instant-NGP’s fast-training hash encoding, coupled with regularization terms for sparse training views.
summary: DWTNeRF is a few-shot NeRF framework using Instant-NGP that distinguishes itself by introducing a Discrete Wavelet Transform loss to prioritize low-frequency learning and multi-head attention for cross-branch interactions.
